chapter_note: Highly substratic chapter on the molding of Man and the war against Hyle. Teaching purity is very high (0.914). Apart from a chapter title (editorial framing) and a single dialogue formula at i=2, the entire chapter is cosmological substrate teaching: the dispatching of the First Man, the storehouses of elements, the analogy of body/limbs/wellsprings, and the death/inactivity of Hyle when its natures are taken. Heavy damage (75%) but no editorial seams detected. The negative editorial fatigue score reflects damage rather than drift — the second half is just more lacunose.
